title: {{NAME}} and the Mighty Dino Robot Team
moral: Every friend has something special they can give.

pages.content: {{NAME}} was a superhero who loved adventures. One day he flew to a big city park. The park had tall trees and shiny paths. A large red robot was standing very still. A big purple dinosaur sat beside the robot. Both of them looked very worried. {{NAME}} landed softly on the grass. "What is wrong?" he asked.

pages.content: The robot said his name was Rex. Rex had run out of power. "My batteries are empty," said Rex sadly. The purple dinosaur said his name was Pip. Pip could not carry Rex alone. He was too heavy. {{NAME}}'s eyes went wide. This was a job for a superhero and his friends.

pages.content: Rex was so happy. He picked up {{NAME}} and Pip in his big arms. He carried them high above the park. They could see the whole city! Every friend has something special they can give. {{NAME}} had speed. Rex had strength. Pip had a warm heart. Together they were the best team.

pages.content: Rex carried them gently back to the soft grass. They lay down under the tall park trees. The sun was going down. It was soft and warm and gold. Every friend has something special they can give. {{NAME}} felt happy and sleepy. He closed his heavy eyes slowly. He wondered what Rex might build for them tomorrow.
